notes: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), hand-edited from the 2026-10-21 advisories. php-radar reads this file at run time, so a new fix or distro build is an edit here and no code change. JSON has no comments, so every entry carries its own notes field.

eol.notes: 8.1, 8.0, 7.4 and every older branch are end of life, and upstream shipped no PHP2Shell fix for any of them. A distro or vendor that patched one anyway goes in backports, which the grader checks before this rule.

backports.notes: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS php8.1, fixed in USN-8948-1 and USN-8948-2. Ubuntu patched its own 8.1.2 base, so the 8.1.2 that php -v prints says nothing about the fix. Later revisions of the same series count as patched.
Debian 13 (trixie) php8.4, fixed in DSA-6574-1. Later revisions of the same series count as patched.
Debian 12 (bookworm) php8.2, fixed in DLA-4848-1, an LTS advisory. Later revisions of the same series count as patched.
Alpine 3.24 php83, listed as fixed in the v3.24 community secdb. Alpine 3.23 and older list no fix, so they are not here.
Alpine 3.24 php84, listed as fixed in the v3.24 community secdb.
Alpine 3.24 php85, listed as fixed in the v3.24 community secdb.
SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP7 php8. SUSE released it as 8.3.36-150700.3.24.1. The bare version covers every release built from 8.3.36 and any later 8.3 point release.
